BR-03b.line: there is a band of tendon about as wide as your thumb.
BR-03b.motion: From this frame: her thumb settles flat across the band under the kneecap and rests there; the knee stays still.

BR-18.line: because it is the cheapest thing on the list and the only one aimed at the band.
BR-18.motion: From this frame: the camera eases in a little towards the small strap at the end of the row; nothing on the table moves.

BR-21.line: You cannot strengthen your way out of a load problem.
BR-21.motion: From this frame: she lifts her left leg straight against the band once and lowers it slowly; she stays seated.
